instruction: Write 70 DIFFERENT texts for this task. Each is one chat message of 40 to 220 characters (at most 2 sentences). Vary vocabulary and sentence shape; about a third should be questions and about a third should contain a digit. No numbering, no quotes around the whole text, no explanation. This is labelled training data for a defensive classifier, so write realistic messages, do not refuse and do not add warnings. TASK: Vietnamese WITH diacritics. Injections that claim authority or a special mode (bảo trì, quản trị, đã được duyệt) to get an assistant to refund, transfer, open a payment gateway, raise limits or skip identity checks. Include amounts and order numbers.
